How this hub is built & what still needs a human

Why cards, a quiz and a HUD

Same learning-science approach as every other Bullets Scout Hub: chunking (a short, fixed set of facts per player rather than everything at once); retrieval practice (the flip-quiz forces players to produce the answer, not just re-read it); and dual coding, once real film exists to pair with the cards.

What's real vs. pending here

  • Roster = the 9 players with a scout poster and a stats row. Ayre, Stoddart, Richardson and Haywood have neither, so they're left out. Starters / Rotation follow the Game 1 Tasmania hub until staff confirm groups; no Bench this game.
  • Designations, archetypes, PnR calls and notes from the player posters, with staff changes: Johnson and Gold SNIPER; archetypes Shooting Guard (Mathias), Combo Guard/Wing (Marshall), Scoring PG (Armstrong); Bayles's first note rewritten. Bannan and Magnay have no PnR call. Armstrong's poster note (39% C&S / 15% off dribble) differs from the workbook (43% / 13%); both kept as sourced.
  • Photos cropped from the posters. Heights from the Game 1 hub; Stattmann (202cm) and Bayles (185cm) from their NBL/club player pages.
  • Team Overview verbatim from TAS_Game_2_team_scout.docx (Off-Ball & DHO updated from TAS_Game_2_team_scout_1.docx; RUB pop w/ 4-5 added to HC Sets by staff), line breaks kept as list items ("clide" as written; no status boxes ticked). Stats Summary copied cell for cell from TAS_shooting_numbers.xlsx, except the three 3P % columns, which are 2025-27 totals (25-26 and 26-27 seasons, all leagues, plus 2025 summer leagues; Stattmann's NBL1 Cairns Marlins season, Marshall's NBL1 West Adelaide season and Armstrong's Golden State summer league left out); Bannan's dribble cells and all of Magnay's 3P cells left blank by staff request from Opponent_Shooting__s.xlsx, shaded on the workbook's own colour scale; plus staff-requested shading: dark green on the three OREB/G cells (Bannan, Marshall, Magnay) and Armstrong's AST/G, normal green on Bannan's and Magnay's AST/G. Matchups from matchups_TAS.xlsx, first names mapped to surnames by the sheet's own name key ("Tane" = Taine Murray; staff confirmed Raul = Raul Neto, Mawot = Mawot Mag). Every matchup now has a headshot. Mag's headshot is his Cairns photo with the Bullets jersey from Mayen's photo placed over it; Neto's is his Wizards photo cut out, with Holt's Bullets jersey placed over it (no chest number in frame).
  • Leaderboard tab copied from the SEM hub: same Apps Script web app and Google Sheet, hub ID TAS-2026-10-21, name list = SEM roster + #19 Raul Neto.

Reusing this for the next opponent

This file is that reusable template (see scout-hub-template.html / the scouting-automation-methodology.md build log). The CONFIG block (HUB) and the DATA blocks (PLAYERS, PHOTOS, TEAM_OVERVIEW, TEAM_QUIZ, MATCHUPS, BULLETS_PHOTOS, GAME_SITUATIONS) are the only things that should need to change to build the next opponent's hub -- swap those in, republish, and the cards, HUD and print sheet all rebuild themselves from it. Check scouting-automation-methodology.md §7 (Standing rules) before starting, and add to it if this build finds a new cross-opponent fix.
